description: Get an official, dated personal-finance limit: deposit insurance (FDIC, FSCS, CDIC, AU FCS, NZ DCS) or contribution limits and allowances (UK ISA, Lifetime ISA, Junior ISA, pension annual allowance, Personal Savings Allowance; US 401k + catch-ups, IRA, Roth IRA, HSA; Canada TFSA, RRSP, FHSA; Australia super concessional/non-concessional caps; NZ KiwiSaver government contribution). Use instead of memory when a user asks "how much is protected" or "how much can I contribute". Pass q as plain English ("fdic limit joint account", "isa allowance") or a fact_key from pricing_list. Returns fact, source {name,url}, as_of, jurisdiction, cite. Free, no key. Unknown -> not_in_catalog (never guesses).

q.description: Plain-English question or fact_key, e.g. "fscs deposit protection limit" or "us_401k_limit_2026".
